profile.name: Himanshu Raturi
profile.tagline: Doctoral Candidate in Information Science & Computer Vision
profile.bio: Researching real-time multi-object tracking, pose estimation, and trajectory prediction in occluded and crowded environments.

education.institution: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
Nara Institute of Science and Technology

bullets: Selected for the Erasmus+ International Credit Mobility (ICM) program under the supervision of Prof. Nicu Sebe and Prof. Paolo Rota.
Conducted advanced computer vision and machine learning research focused on multi-object tracking and visual analysis in crowded environments.
Member of the Mobility Research Group at the Graduate School of Informatics.
Collaborating on mobility analysis and mathematical modeling projects.
Developed desktop applications using Python and the PyQt framework.
Implemented backend functionality using SQLite databases for efficient data management.

projects.title: Real-Time Tracking of Individuals in Crowded Environments
bullets: Developing a tracking pipeline combining YOLOv8 (detection), MMPose (pose estimation), and ViT (ReID).
Focused on improving trajectory prediction accuracy in occluded and crowded scenes.

projects.title: Shopping Assistant Chatbot
bullets: Built a conversational agent for personal shopping using Dialogflow and Django.
Integrated a recommender system to suggest products based on user preferences.
Deployed the full stack application on Heroku.

projects.title: Fantasy Cricket Platform
bullets: Developed an online fantasy sports game where users draft virtual teams based on real-world player statistics.
Implemented ranking algorithms to calculate user scores based on live match performance.

projects.title: YouTube Media Automation
bullets: Created a desktop application and subsequent bot to automate the extraction of audio (MP3) from YouTube videos.
Focused on high-quality conversion and streamlined user experience.
